name: Status
definition: The status of an instruction, advice or request.

StatusDateTime.name: Status Date Time
StatusDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the status was assigned.

StatusDescription.name: Status Description
StatusDescription.definition: Specifies the state or the condition.

InstructionProcessingStatus.name: Instruction Processing Status
InstructionProcessingStatus.definition: Status of the processing of an instruction.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Status of settlement of a transaction.

CancellationProcessingStatus.name: Cancellation Processing Status
CancellationProcessingStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a cancellation request.

TransactionProcessingStatus.name: Transaction Processing Status
TransactionProcessingStatus.definition: Status of processing of a transaction at account servicer level.

ModificationProcessingStatus.name: Modification Processing Status
ModificationProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of a modification request.

StatusReason.name: Status Reason
StatusReason.definition: Specifies the reasons for the status.

ValidityTime.name: Validity Time
ValidityTime.definition: Period of time during which the status is valid.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of assigning a status.
